TSB Revision
MULTIPORT FUEL INJECTION (MFI) <3.0L ENGINE>
13B-492
STEP 6. Check the backup power supply voltage at ECM 
harness side connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM harness side 
connector C-55 <A/T>.
(1) Disconnect the connector C-58 <M/T> or C-55 <A/T> and 
measure at the harness side.
(2) Measure the voltage between terminal 60 <M/T> or 66 <A/
T> and ground.
• Voltage should be battery positive voltage.
Q: Is the voltage normal?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Check harness connector C-28, C-78 and C-89 at 
intermediate connector for damage, and repair or 
replace as required. Refer to, GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection (P.00E-2). If intermediate 
connectors are in good condition, repair harness wire 
between fusible link (4) and ECM connector C-58 
terminal 60 <M/T> or PCM connector C-55 terminal 
66 <A/T> because of open circuit. Then confirm that 
the malfunction symptom is eliminated.
STEP 7. Check the continuity at ECM harness side 
connector C-58 <M/T> or PCM harness side connector C-
55 <A/T>.
(1) Disconnect the connector C-58 <M/T> or C-55 <A/T> and 
measure at the harness side.
(2) Check for the continuity between terminal (58, 46) <M/T> or 
(42, 48) <A/T> and ground.
• Should be less than 2 ohm.
Q: Is the continuity normal?
YES : Go to Step 8.
NO : Repair harness wire between ECM connector C-58 
terminal (58, 46) <M/T> or PCM connector C-55 
terminal (42, 48) <A/T> and ground because of open 
circuit or harness damage. Then confirm that the 
malfunction symptom is eliminated.
